scientific_scope: Completed exploratory robustness ablations on exposed AIT audit events; not a novel mechanism or external confirmation
metric_comparisons: Independent sklearn confusion/precision/recall/F1/continuous-score ROC-AUC/AP plus direct coverage arithmetic, pooled and per run at both thresholds
threshold_audit_limit: Original calibration predictions were not saved. Authorized derivative inference on frozen clean calibration inputs exactly reproduced all four stored thresholds and confusion counts using an independent sorted-negative rank calculation; feature generation reused the reviewed frozen replay implementation.
provenance_limit: File timestamps and frozen source hashes support execution consistency; they are not an independently attested execution log. NPZ hashes are bound at audit time; they were not precommitted predictions.
limitations: All 44 positive test events share the author escalation label and are correlated source events, not44 independent attacks.
AIT data and earlier test outcomes are exposed development data.
Other-label negatives follow source rules, not independent analyst adjudication.
22,873 of 22,890 events are singleton records; random record deletion usually removes the entire event.
Offline roster keeps completely unseen targets in denominators and forces no alarm; it does not implement a deployed trigger for invisible events.
Three random seeds vary deletion masks only, not independent model fits, campaigns or population samples.
At deadline at least injected delay, recovery to clean inputs is guaranteed by simulation construction, not learned robustness.
No simultaneous significance, confidence intervals or novelty established.

calibration_threshold_verification.independent_selector: Sorted clean-calibration negative scores; index n_negative-floor(0.01*n_negative)-1; strict score > selected value. No evaluated calibration helper imported.
calibration_threshold_verification.feature_generation: Original hash-verified frozen replay module reused; only calibration matrices evaluated.
calibration_threshold_verification.authorized_exception: Root explicitly authorized saved-model calibration-only inference after initial saved-output audit. Model byte hashes checked before trusted local joblib load. No fit, test inference, tuning, or source/result mutation.
